description: The largest fort in India, sprawling over 700 acres atop a 180-metre high hill, renowned for Vijay Stambha and Kirti Stambha.
Mewar fortress on the westerly range of Aravalli Hills, birthplace of Maharana Pratap, featuring a 36-kilometre continuous outer perimeter wall.
Colonnaded temple complex dedicated to Surya, built atop a plateau overlooking the Kashmir Valley, synthesized from Gandharan, Gupta, and Roman classical forms.
Largest and best preserved fort in Kerala, built of laterite slabs rising directly from the Arabian Sea coastline.

architecture: Deccan Fortification and Hill Citadel Architecture
description: Nearly impregnable hill fortress carved into a conical pyramidal rock with a subterranean dark labyrinth (Andhari) and the Chand Minar minaret.
Five-storey deep subterranean stepwell carved in sandstone, adorned with intricate geometric friezes and floral motifs.
Historic capital of the Qutb Shahi sultanate famous for acoustic marvels, diamond trade vault (Koh-i-Noor provenance), and massive granite fortifications.
